resolutions: Parent templates: the bank field `template` takes only 4 values (0-3); the lock says 12 parent templates. The 12 clusters are domain x template (`{domain}/T{template}`), the convention of every earlier audit of this bank (scripts/audit_r3_20260923.py) and of Experiment B (scripts/latest0924/analyze_graded.py). Families nest in them.

Engineering gate: the lock text names max logit difference <= 0.05 with equal parsed answers; the pinned evaluator (the manifest pins src/syncomm/recovery/evaluate_confirm.py) also requires alias-gap difference <= 0.1. The script applies the evaluator's three-clause gate (stricter) and also reports the lock-literal two-clause count. qwen3.5-122b-a10b uses ADR-latest0924-moe-gate (parsed answers equal and alias gap <= 0.1).

Engineering failure is receiver-level: a failure in any sender's cell makes the receiver an engineering failure for every sender (the lock: "A receiver failing the gate is reported as an engineering failure with no outcome rows").

"Lower limit > 0 after Holm" (H1, H2): Holm (alpha 0.05) is applied to p = max(two-sided bootstrap p at the family level, at the template level), each p pooled over the 3 seeds x 20,000 draws; the decision additionally requires the unadjusted 95% seed-enclosing interval to exclude 0 in the stated direction at BOTH levels. This is the rule already used for Experiment B (scripts/latest0924/analyze_graded.py). Holm-adjusted p values are also reported.

Holm family size m: the receivers EVALUATED for that sender (complete, engineering-passed, audit-passed, cross-model). As a sensitivity, the verdict is also computed with m = every planned cross-model receiver of that sender (unevaluated receivers enter with p = 1); disagreements are listed.
H1 point criteria use family-macro point estimates: J(selected) >= 0.50 and coverage(selected) >= 0.90 at 64 tokens.

H2 order: "internal better" / "text better" are checked before "similar" (the lock lists them first); a pair that is both significant and within +/-3 points is labelled by its significant direction and flagged within_margin=true. "Similar" uses the unadjusted 95% seed-enclosing intervals at both levels, inclusive bounds [-0.03, +0.03].

Same-model pairs (lock same_model_pairs) are reported in their own table with unadjusted intervals and p (no Holm), are excluded from every cross-model count and Holm family, and are excluded from the H3 secondary ladder.

H3 secondary: gap = family-macro J(selected) - J(packet_text) at 64 tokens; Spearman with average ranks over the available ladder points (qwen3.5-27b and qwen3.6-27b tie at 27e9); computed only when >= 3 points exist. Missing points (engineering failures, incomplete cells) are listed, never imputed.
"Reassigned success/valid" in the main table = the range of J over sham0-sham2 / the mean coverage over sham0-sham2.
Cells whose development shards are not all receipted are INCOMPLETE and are reported as NOT RUN for inference (the lock's execution_order), with the rows present.
